summary: Day/night switch whose sun pixels rebuild as a crescent moon while night sweeps the sky; it can set the page theme.

attributes.name: controls-page
attributes.description: Presence attribute. When set, each toggle writes `data-theme="dark"` or `"light"` and toggles the `.dark` class on the `<html>` element, the switch follows theme changes made elsewhere on the page, and a hint under the switch says so.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires on every toggle with the new state; not when the switch follows a page theme change.

methods.description: Switches between day and night and fires `change`. With `controls-page`, also sets the page theme.

accessibility: The control is a native button with `role="switch"`, `aria-label="Dark mode"` and `aria-checked` for the night state.
The "Light" / "Dark" label below is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
motion: With reduced motion, the switch changes state at once without the pixel morph, the clouds stop drifting and the stars stop twinkling.
notes: The initial state comes from `data-theme` on `<html>` (`dark` or `light`), then the `.dark` class, then `prefers-color-scheme`. Without `controls-page`, later page theme changes do not move the switch.
The sky, sun and moon use fixed colours rather than theme tokens. The switch is a fixed 156 by 72px.
